$comment: The two respin packs as App Store Connect shows them. scripts/store/iap.mjs pushes this file; packages/respins/test/iap.test.ts fails if a product id, count or price here disagrees with RESPIN_PACKS. Display name max 30 characters, description max 45. See docs/respins.md.
reviewNote: Respins are a consumable that redraws the franchise and era a spin just landed on, before the player picks from it. To find it: tap Play, then Spin The Wheel; when the spin lands, a "↻ Respin" button with the player's balance appears under the team and era. With a balance of 0 it opens the purchase sheet with both packs. One respin can be used per season. A season that used one is marked ↻ on every leaderboard and never counts toward the perfect-season board; the sheet states the odds (every eligible franchise-era is equally likely). Purchases are verified server-side from the StoreKit 2 signed transaction and credited to the player's account; an account is created automatically (anonymously) when needed, so no sign-in is required to buy.
